biotools.summary: ClinGen defines the clinical relevance of genes and variants for medical and research use, developing standards for data sharing and curation. The resource provides curated data on gene-disease relationships, pathogenicity of genetic variation, dosage sensitivity, and actionability of gene-disease interventions, available through a web portal.
